patch_description: Replace the static global R (from MAD of first differences) with an innovation-based, EWMA-smoothed adaptive measurement variance in the forward pass only: R[k] = 0.5·R0 + 0.5·ewma_var. This widens R during noise bursts (more smoothing, fewer slope changes) and tightens it during clean segments (better tracking/lag), improving noise reduction without adding any pipeline stage or touching the state update (which stays purely x_est = xp[k] + K·innov, per the lesson that signal-shaping additions poison output). Both RTS refinement passes use the same time-varying R sequence for consistency.
